observation: outlier_filter: Only 2 clean months, need 3. Well has two distinct production phases: Phase 1 (1993-1998, max 352 bbl/mo conventional) and Phase 2 (2008, max 8862 bbl/mo recompletion). With 12-month holdout, training ends at Apr 2008 — only 4 months of Phase 2 in training (Jan-Apr 2008). Peak detection with any smoothing_window>=2 anchors at Mar 2008 (index 182) because zeros before Phase 2 drag down smoothed values at Feb 2008. This leaves only 2 months post-peak (Mar, Apr), failing min_clean_months=3. Phase 1 peaks (max 352) can never be 'significant' vs Phase 2 (max 8862) — even at significance_threshold=0.30, cutoff is 2659 bbl. Tried outlier_threshold=0.50, outlier_window=5/7, significance_threshold=0.75 — all fail for the same structural reason. CONCLUSION: well is unfittable with current hindcast framework. The 12-month holdout consumes the Phase 2 decline, leaving insufficient training data after peak detection. No parameter in the allowed search space can resolve this.
